status: DCC complete and source stable; native Unity/video/interactive acceptance reported separately.
result_ko: 이전의 공통 발 회수 원호를 제거하고 실제 개 질주의 큰 발 궤적과 몸통 운동을 복원했습니다. 앞발은 코끝 선까지 뻗고 뒷발은 뒤로 밀고 몸 아래로 회수하며 실제 공중기가 포함됩니다.
result_en: Replaced the previous shared paw-return arc with the captured canine gallop paw trajectories and body movement. Fore reach reaches the muzzle line, hind drive pushes back, collection gathers feet below the body and actual aerial poses are present.
reference: User supplied German Shepherd running photograph; visual pose reference, not a downloaded or redistributed model.

source_capture.dataset: Han et al. (2024), Lifelike Agility and Play in Quadrupedal Robots using Reinforcement Learning and Generative Pre-trained Models

changes: Full captured nonuniform fore/hind paw translations and spinal/pelvis movement replace the prior uniform sin-squared swings.
Retimed source cycle to 0.5 seconds, world paw scale0.85, root stays in place; nominal translation3.063375910135234m/s.
Airborne fore reach enhanced by at most6.5cm with bounded scapular glide at most6.3cm. Loaded stance reconciled to one common translation speed.
Anatomical length-preserving IK uses rest-calibrated elbow/stifle/hock direction; wrist is the actual solved lower-leg endpoint.
Authored sagittal carpal/toe pitch replaces incompatible captured3D ankle rotations. Forward toes point down and recovery folds naturally; no source yaw/roll wrist copying.
Quaternion key hemispheres align throughout new Run to prevent intermediate-frame skin interpolation artifacts. Actual heel as well as toes participates in floor correction.
Ear/tail follow-through authored; no hands added.

clips.name: Run
clips.source: Captured large nonuniform paw translations, footfall timing and body motion; anatomical model IK with original-rest bend directions, contact/heel polish, scapular glide, calibrated authored sagittal carpal/toe pitch and ear/tail follow-through. Original 3D ankle rotations are not copied.

validation.scope: Original rest geometry, rest matrices, audited weights, morphs and coat mask are byte-exact; old binaries and care/Walk keys preserved; 120Hz full skin/bend direction/loop/quaternion/flight/no-pop and actual delivered FBX checked.
validation.independent_review_receipt: gallop-independent-review.json (final independent review pending at summary creation)

limits: Paw rotation, contact polish, scapular glide and extra forward reach are authored adaptations rather than literal unchanged mocap.
Run is in place; root runtime moves at the manifest nominal speed.
No attack, retrieve, feed, human hand or additional walk clip added.
